COMMUNICATION
Match.

1. What’s the date today?                                           a. You should see a doctor.
2. Would you like to come to the cinema with us?               b. It’s 6th December.
3. What’s wrong?                                                      c. I can’t wait for it.
4. I don’t know what to do. Any ideas?                          d. I’m sorry, I’ve got other plans.
5. Don’t miss Peter’s party.                                           e. I think I’ve got the flu.
6. What are you going to do this summer?                               f. I’m going to travel around South America.

READ                                                  TravellerRead the health advice website and answer the questions.



              http://www.nursenad.com

  Nurse Nadia’s Online help...

  Dear Nurse Nadia,
    I think I have a problem. You see, I woke up yesterday with a really bad headache and backache.
    I took painkillers, but they didn’t help. Today I have a terrible sore throat and a temperature.
   Also, when I try to eat something, I get a stomach ache. Is it serious? Should I go to a doctor?
   Sick in Surrey

  Dear Sick,
  That sounds like the flu! You should drink a lot of fluids, like water and orange juice, and get
  some rest. Your body is tired and going to school or work isn’t going to help at all. You shouldn’t
  go out, just stay in bed. If you still feel bad in a few days, you should definitely see a doctor!
  Take care,
  Nurse


1. What problems did the person have yesterday?
2. What happens when the person eats something?
3. What does the nurse think the person has?
4. Where shouldn’t the person go?
